description: Inaugural fund of MGX, the Abu Dhabi AI investment firm anchored by Mubadala and G42; closed July 2026 at $49B against a $45B target, one of the largest dedicated AI vehicles ever raised. Invests across the AI stack — semiconductors, AI infrastructure, and AI companies — with prior bets on OpenAI, Anthropic, xAI and the Aligned Data Centres consortium.

KKR's fifth and largest global infrastructure fund, closed August 2026 at $19.2B; a Core+ vehicle targeting critical infrastructure in North America and Western Europe. Over $9B already committed, including digital-infrastructure positions such as Global Technical Realty and Gulf Data Hub.

AI research and safety company behind the Claude model family, founded in 2021 by former OpenAI researchers. Amazon, its largest backer, has invested over $13B and in April 2026 committed up to $20B more tied to commercial milestones; Anthropic in turn committed ~$100B to AWS over a decade and up to 5GW of Trainium capacity.

Third Melbourne data-center campus of STACK Infrastructure, the Blue Owl-managed digital infrastructure platform; STACK is seeking an A$8.5B (US$5.9B) syndicated loan to fund the build — potentially one of the largest data-center financings in Australia. Talks with banks were at an early stage as of late July 2026.

target: Project Sopaipilla Holdings (Meta El Paso data center JV)
description: Joint venture between Meta (20%) and BlackRock-managed funds (80%) to develop a 1GW data center in El Paso, Texas — ~$14B total development cost funded with ~$4.9B BlackRock cash, ~$2.3B of Meta land and construction assets, and $12.5B of debt. Meta leases the entire campus, with capacity expected online from 2028.

Data and AI platform company (the 'lakehouse') founded by the creators of Apache Spark and led by Ali Ghodsi. In July 2026 it announced a ~$3B strategic round led by existing investor Coatue at a $188B valuation — its second raise of 2026, up 40% from the $134B mark set in February.

Amsterdam-headquartered, Nasdaq-listed AI cloud ('neocloud') provider that emerged from the former Yandex N.V. NVIDIA invested $2B via pre-funded warrants in a March 2026 private placement — a ~9.3% stake disclosed in a July 13D filing — alongside a partnership targeting more than 5GW of NVIDIA-powered AI capacity by 2030.

Unnamed U.S. chip fab receiving a $1.0B incremental construction funding from Brookfield in Q2 2026, per Brookfield Asset Management's results release. Brookfield's flagship fab exposure is its semiconductor co-investment partnership with Intel (up to $15B for 49% of Intel's Arizona fab expansion), with which this funding is consistent, though the release does not name the facility.

AI inference hardware company founded by Gavin Uberti and Rob Wachen, building rack-scale inference clusters (with technologies like Low Voltage Inference and Cluster Scale Memory) after starting with its transformer-specialized Sohu chip. Raised a $300M Series C led by Sequoia at a $10.3B valuation in July 2026, with a16z, Jane Street and SK Hynix; over $1B raised in total.

target: Genesis Mission first project cohort (278 projects)
description: First cohort of 278 projects selected under the Genesis Mission, the U.S. Department of Energy's AI-for-science initiative — 87 led by DOE/NNSA national labs, 168 by universities and 19 by companies, spanning nuclear energy, fusion, critical minerals and intelligent chip design. DOE called it the largest response to a funding opportunity in its history.

Santa Clara semiconductor-equipment maker founded in 2010 and led by David K. Lam (Lam Research's founding CEO), building multi-column e-beam lithography systems for advanced packaging, chip-ID security and photonics. Received a $140M letter of intent under the CHIPS R&D program in July 2026 for advanced packaging technology to assemble and stack multiple chips.

Delaware special-purpose vehicle formed by Khosla Ventures in 2026 (Vinod Khosla, Samir Kaul and Sven Strohband listed as managing directors), which raised $60.5M per an August 2026 Form D. The underlying portfolio company ('MM') is not disclosed in the filing; the vehicle is structured as a venture capital fund.

San Francisco hardware-security company building non-invasive counterfeit and malicious-component detection for AI and defense chip supply chains; its ReelScan platform uses RF fingerprinting to authenticate ICs on component reels. Received a $34M letter of intent under the CHIPS R&D program in July 2026.

Santa Barbara startup (formerly Tacitly, Inc.) building AI-enabled workforce skill measurement and optimization for enterprises adopting generative AI; co-founded by researchers Matt Beane (UCSB) and Juho Kim (KAIST), with Reid Hoffman on the board per its August 2026 Form D, which reports ~$15.1M sold of a ~$17.1M offering.

Physical-AI company (Project Prometheus) co-founded and co-led by Jeff Bezos and former Verily co-founder Vik Bajaj, building an 'artificial general engineer' to automate design and manufacturing of complex physical systems — jet engines to drug compounds. Launched late 2025 with $6.2B and raised a further $12B at a $41B valuation in mid-2026.

AI interface startup from Udemy and Carbon Health founder Eren Bali (with Edouard Tabet and Murat Akbal) that answers queries with generated visual, interactive interfaces instead of chat text; launched from stealth July 2026 with an iOS app and a $40M seed led by DST Global and Lux Capital, with angels including Garry Tan and Arthur Mensch.

Delaware limited partnership formed in 2026 by GPx, the venture firm of ex-Founders Fund GP Brian Singerman and Quiet Capital's Lee Linden (backed by Peter Thiel); the July 2026 Form D lists an indefinite offering with no sales yet. The 'TX' vehicle's specific purpose is undisclosed — GPx's model backs emerging seed managers and leads later-stage rounds in their breakout companies.

target: Andreessen Horowitz Fund X-B - AI Infrastructure, L.P.
description: Delaware venture fund vehicle in a16z's Fund X family dedicated to AI infrastructure, per a July 2026 Form D (indefinite offering; Marc Andreessen and Ben Horowitz as principals). Part of a16z's ~$3B AI-infrastructure strategy within its $15B early-2026 raise, backing systems that help technical teams build, secure and deploy AI.
